newsitem.title: USA: Calif. realtors association sponsors reform bills.
newsitem.headline: Calif. realtors association sponsors reform bills.

text.p: California Association of Realtors said Thursday it would sponsor a package of state legislation to reform real estate transactions in the state.
Senate Bill 319, by Sen. John Burton, would allow a buyer to assume the seller's title insurance policy.
Assembly Bill 1524, by Assemblyman Robert Prenter, would repeal the co-called "50 percent rule" that prevents affiliated title companies from receiving title business from parent firms.

Assembly Bill 1516, by Assemblyman Ed Vincent, would allow a real estate licensee to act as the sales agent of a title insurer. Enabling real estate agents to broker related products will promote "one-stop shopping" for insurance, real estate and other related services, the association said.
California Realtors, one of the largest state trade associations with nearly 100,000 members, said its legislative package would streamline real estate transactions in the state.
